purpose: Consolidated generated-concept register; proposal counts are not counts of validated leads or patent-novel assets.
assembly_method: Mapped from the three domain memos, neuro/metabolic generated-concepts JSON and root POLG handoff. No new literature research performed for this consolidation.

novelty_definition.new_to_repo: New exact lead or hypothesis relative to the reviewed inventory; may already be published, patented or in clinical development.
novelty_definition.refinement: An existing concept with a materially changed construct specification, route, timing, selection rule, comparator or decisive experiment.
novelty_definition.untested_combination: Defined parts combined in a proposed configuration whose incremental joint benefit is not established by the mapped evidence.

merged_proposals.reason: Both propose BPG10 plus full-length recombinant PRG4/lubricin to combine cartilage charge support and boundary lubrication.

original_dispositions.BL-N09: Reserve; require factorial bulk-load and friction benefit.

family_overlap.counting_rule: Two distinct design records in one family, not two independent platform discoveries.
family_overlap.design_distinction: NM-N05 uses vanillic acid plus CoQ10 in COQ9/selected COQ7 disease; NM-N06 tests 2,4-DHB add-on to CoQ10 in COQ8B nephropathy. The former combination has published mouse evidence; the latter proposed add-on still needs incremental function.

family_overlap.counting_rule: A single-agent workflow and an untested add-on design share AAT evidence; do not count them as independent efficacy confirmations.
family_overlap.design_distinction: BE-N01 prioritizes qualified AAT alone and washout durability; BE-N10 adds solnatide only after the single-agent proof.

cross_comparators.relationship: Topical insulin is both its own product/benchmark lane and the decisive active comparator for mIGF; distinct materials, not duplicate proposals.
Cognate tRNA and GCN2iB interrogate related GARS1 pathobiology but are different interventions; exact GCN2iB is downgraded.

proposals.name: Matrix-phenotype-selected PslG plus antibiotic
proposals.exact_component: Soluble PslG residues 31–442 plus tobramycin as the initial antibiotic benchmark; tag state and any protease-resistance variant must be explicitly fixed.

novelty_classification.basis: The domain screen found no PslG entry in the reviewed inventory; the new contribution is substrate-phenotype selection and a viable-clearance product test.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Primary enzyme studies and a 2026 comparison of 14 clinical isolates support substrate-dependent biofilm disruption and antibiotic-associated effects.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Biomass reduction is not sterilization; prior pulmonary coadministration does not prove treatment of established infection, and dissemination is a material boundary.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: In established clinical-isolate biofilms, compare PslG, antibiotic, combination and inactive enzyme; quantify viable residual and dispersed organisms after physiological protease exposure and washout.

disposition.reason: Advance only if matrix selection predicts materially greater killing without increased viable dissemination.

proposals.name: Native DNase1L2 for actin-rich airway mucus
proposals.exact_component: Recombinant native human DNase1L2; do not substitute a PEGylated preparation without separately specifying it.

novelty_classification.basis: An exact native nuclease replaces the nonspecific idea of a better DNase.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Recombinant protein reduced viscosity in actin-enriched artificial cystic-fibrosis mucus; production and PEGylation were reported.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Native patient sputum transport and superiority to dornase or an actin-resistant clinical benchmark are unestablished.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Across independent patient sputum donors, compare native DNase1L2 with dornase and an actin-resistant benchmark using mucus transport and rheology, not DNA digestion alone.

disposition.reason: Artificial mucus efficacy is insufficient for an inhaled product thesis.

proposals.name: Qualified topical insulin for neurotrophic epithelial defects
proposals.exact_component: Human insulin in a specifically selected and stability-validated ocular vehicle; the memo does not fix a final formulation.

novelty_classification.basis: New to the reviewed inventory, but already an established clinical research and formulation topic.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Human treatment series, a registered active randomized comparison and vehicle-dependent stability studies support a practical comparator/product lane.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: A generic insulin eye-drop concept is not a differentiated asset; the ongoing trial is not completed comparative proof.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Compare a qualified formulation under tear-like washout in persistent epithelial repair models, measuring durable closure, barrier restoration and ocular handling stability.

disposition.reason: Highly obtainable and scientifically credible, but differentiation and existing formulation claims constrain discovery priority.

proposals.name: Retained topical losartan for established corneal fibrosis
proposals.exact_component: Losartan in a retained ocular formulation; final excipient/retention system remains unspecified.

novelty_classification.basis: New inventory entry for a formulation-dependent corneal indication, not a newly discovered molecule or unclaimed use.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Published corneal work and an eight-eye 2026 series provide a direct starting point.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: The eight-eye series showed no significant group improvement in visual, topographic or densitometric outcomes.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Test established corneal scars against an appropriate active comparator at measured, tolerable stromal exposure; require durable transparency/mechanical improvement after washout.

disposition.reason: Retention must produce an incremental functional effect rather than repeat a weak broad efficacy claim.

proposals.name: Topical PDE4 inhibition for post-injury epithelial adhesion rescue
proposals.exact_component: Topical roflumilast, with apremilast as the mechanistic benchmark; these drugs are not interchangeable evidence.

novelty_classification.basis: Changes the route and post-injury product question relative to the repository oral-apremilast concept.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Apremilast pretreatment improved adhesion biology in injected healthy human skin; follow-up supports Epac1 involvement.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Topical roflumilast has not reproduced that result in established human autoimmune injury; prevention and injected exposure do not establish clinical topical efficacy.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: After pathogenic-IgG injury in human skin or oral mucosa, measure tissue exposure, mechanical cohesion and barrier recovery with topical roflumilast versus relevant active therapy.

disposition.reason: The intended route must attain useful exposure and reverse established cohesion loss.

proposals.name: Defined dual KLK5/KLK7 cyclic peptide for local Netherton treatment
proposals.exact_component: A disclosed SFTI-1 analogue or phage-selected dual KLK5/KLK7 cyclic peptide; the source memo does not select a single sequence.

novelty_classification.basis: New specific material route in the screen; selecting the exact sequence remains a discovery decision.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Primary peptide series disclose sequences and inhibitory potencies; LEKTI and clinical KLK programs are available comparators.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Enzyme inhibition has not yet established durable SPINK5-deficient human epidermal barrier rescue for the proposed product.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Select one sequence and compare barrier function, proteolysis and local exposure in SPINK5-deficient human epidermis against LEKTI/KLK benchmarks.

disposition.reason: Competition and incomplete article selection prevent near-term promotion.

proposals.name: GM-CSF variant escaping pathogenic aPAP autoantibodies
proposals.exact_component: Engineered human GM-CSF with retained receptor activation and reduced pathogenic-antibody binding; no exact variant is supplied.

novelty_classification.basis: New exploratory protein-engineering hypothesis, not an obtainable validated drug article.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: A 2026 primary study mapped patient-derived autoantibody epitopes/affinities across 28 patients.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: No defined escape variant with preserved receptor activity or broad patient-antibody escape is established by that evidence.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: First generate a sequence-defined variant and test receptor-dependent macrophage function across independent patient antibody preparations, including affinity-diverse controls.

disposition.reason: The crucial component must still be discovered; an epitope map is not a therapeutic construct.

proposals.name: Genotype-defined topical readthrough for SERPINB7 Nagashima keratosis
proposals.exact_component: Topical gentamicin in patients with a susceptible SERPINB7 nonsense variant; formulation and genotype window must be prespecified.

novelty_classification.basis: New inventory-level indication and functional-selection question; gentamicin readthrough itself is published.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: A five-patient bilateral randomized study and patient-cell readthrough provide direct human starting evidence.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Restoration of functional inhibitor versus antibiotic-mediated effects, durable benefit and commercial differentiation remain unresolved.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Use variant-defined patient epidermis to compare gentamicin with controls, linking full-length functional SERPINB7 restoration to barrier recovery rather than antibacterial effects.

disposition.reason: Modest human evidence warrants a bounded functional proof, not an S-tier claim.

proposals.name: BPG10 plus full-length recombinant PRG4 for cartilage mechanics
proposals.exact_component: BPG10: approximately 180-kDa chondroitin-sulfate brush on an approximately 10-kDa poly(acrylic acid) core, plus defined full-length recombinant PRG4/lubricin.

novelty_classification.basis: The two domain proposals name the same charge-support plus boundary-lubrication combination and are counted once.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: BPG10 has local micromechanical evidence in four normal and four OA human donors; PRG4 supplies a separately motivated boundary-lubrication comparator.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Neither source establishes combined human bulk load support or superiority of the combination; AFM indents are technical measurements within donors.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Paired human OA explants with both singles and combination under cyclic loading/washout, requiring incremental bulk fluid-load support and lower friction without impaired viability.

disposition.reason: Promote only if separate bulk and friction defects are corrected and combination outperforms the better single component.

proposals.name: Low-frequency mIGF-Gel tested against insulin under washout
proposals.exact_component: Biotin-capped D-phenylalanine–YIGSSSR peptide, assembled as the published mIGF gel; independently authenticate sequence, stereochemistry and assembly.

novelty_classification.basis: The molecular material already exists in the repository; this reframes the active comparator, washout and dosing-frequency specification.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Rat acute debridement and steroid-suppressed delayed-healing studies support retention and epithelial repair.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Human neurotrophic efficacy and a practical advantage over topical insulin are not established.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: In paired corneal models with persistent repair limitation and repeated tear-like washout, compare exact mIGF, an appropriate physical gel control, insulin and free IGF1 on durable closure/barrier and optical quality.

disposition.reason: A meaningful reduction in dosing burden or superior durable repair against insulin would define a product; PBS superiority would not.

proposals.name: Controlled AAT additive for donor-lung repair during EVLP
proposals.exact_component: Plasma-derived alpha-1-antitrypsin/A1PI, with Zemaira as the manufactured reference; warm-circuit compatibility and active concentration require qualification.

novelty_classification.basis: AAT perfusion repair is a newly generated product thesis relative to the reviewed inventory, with a lower-dose/washout contribution beyond published use.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: A paired declined-human-lung study involved eight independent donors; pig EVLP and separate recipient-systemic AAT experiments support organ physiology.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: The apparent 2020/2026 reports should not be counted as independent datasets; ex-vivo-only post-washout transplant durability is unproven.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Use donor-paired lungs and protein/excipient-matched optimized perfusion to test lower-dose active AAT and persistence after washout, followed by ex-vivo-only survival transplantation.

disposition.reason: Strong human physiological foundation and concrete supply; a new project must add durability, dose control or reproducibility, with known rights weighted separately.

proposals.name: Plasminogen replenishment plus alteplase in kidney NMP
proposals.exact_component: Human plasminogen plus alteplase in normothermic kidney perfusion; qualify activity/excipients if using a clinical plasminogen product such as Ryplazim.

novelty_classification.basis: A newly generated substrate-complete kidney microvascular rescue thesis, distinct from existing kidney antioxidant/perfusion concepts.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Human kidney experiments support relief of microvascular obstruction; the central paired efficacy cohort was three donor pairs within a larger organ program.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Thirty-nine organs are not thirty-nine independent paired efficacy observations; filtration and post-transplant benefit are not established.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Randomized contralateral kidneys comparing combination, component controls and optimized NMP, using filtered-tracer clearance and perfusion uniformity after washout.

disposition.reason: Clear substrate lesion and attainable components, but functional recovery must exceed histological plug clearance.

proposals.name: Brief MAM exposure at renal reperfusion
proposals.exact_component: Diacetoxymethyl malonate (MAM), distinguished from dimethyl malonate (DMM), as a timed reperfusion intervention.

novelty_classification.basis: New exact chemical/timing concept in the inventory.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Human/pig succinate mechanism and mouse renal functional rescue support treatment at reperfusion.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Treated-human-kidney efficacy is absent; benefit is sensitive to timing and metabolically realistic perfusate conditions.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Treat human donor kidneys at reperfusion with MAM versus DMM and vehicle under clinically realistic perfusion; require filtration/energy recovery after washout.

disposition.reason: Mechanistic rationale is strong enough to test, but human treatment function and context sensitivity remain decisive.

proposals.name: Local DiNAC lysis of VWF/platelet-rich obstructive clot
proposals.exact_component: N,N′-diacetyl-L-cystine (DiNAC); it is chemically distinct from N-acetylcysteine.

novelty_classification.basis: New exact disulfide-directed clot-phenotype concept.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Human-blood flow and patient-clot work support effects on white VWF/platelet-rich clot.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Red fibrinous clot resistance, achievable local exposure and bleeding/endothelial safety are unresolved; related NAC clinical harms cannot be ignored or equated directly.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: At measured physiological-plasma local exposure, test phenotype-defined patient clots under flow for restored passage, viable distal embolic burden and endothelial injury versus active lysis controls.

disposition.reason: Advance only with a defined susceptible clot phenotype and a useful local exposure/safety window.

proposals.name: Apotransferrin timed to post-transfusion iron release
proposals.exact_component: Human apotransferrin delivered over the transient non-transferrin-bound-iron window after transfusion.

novelty_classification.basis: A narrow transient-exposure thesis, distinct from chronic anemia treatment.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Human serum/bacterial-growth relationships and mouse rescue support the short iron-burst hypothesis; human binding activity is reported.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Chronic anemia benefit was not established, and transient iron binding alone is not evidence of tissue protection.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: In transfusion-relevant human material, compare timed apotransferrin with matched controls on NTBI neutralization plus a prespecified tissue or cellular functional injury endpoint.

disposition.reason: A short-window benefit may survive the negative chronic-anemia result, but needs direct functional demonstration.

proposals.name: Reversible calcium chelation plus taurine for cold platelet storage
proposals.exact_component: EGTA-mediated reversible calcium chelation during storage plus taurine, with verified restoration of calcium-dependent function before use.

novelty_classification.basis: Combines separately supported anti-activation/clearance and metabolic interventions; their joint benefit has not been demonstrated.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Taurine was studied in ten human donors; EGTA pretreatment has mouse functional support; current unmodified cold platelets have a major randomized clinical comparator.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Combination benefit, post-transfusion recovery and superiority over contemporary prolonged cold storage are unproven.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Donor-blocked factorial storage study comparing each component and combination against current cold-storage practice, followed by recovery and hemostatic-function testing after calcium restoration.

disposition.reason: A storage biomarker or repeated twenty-one-day clotting result is insufficient differentiation.

proposals.name: DNase plus plasminogen to unlock retained tPA in resistant thrombi
proposals.exact_component: DNase I plus human plasminogen in a thrombus already exposed to tPA; extra tPA is an active comparator, not an assumed required third new component.

novelty_classification.basis: Refines existing DNase/fibrinolysis concepts around a measured retained-tPA and substrate/NET bottleneck.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: A 205-thrombus study supports the retained-tPA/substrate hypothesis.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Clinical DNase evidence is mixed; a small pilot failed its recanalization endpoint, and a retrieved larger-trial abstract did not supply final efficacy results.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: In resistant patient thrombi with measured retained tPA, compare DNase, plasminogen combination and additional fibrinolytic under flow, using reperfusion and embolic fragments rather than clot weight alone.

disposition.reason: A useful mechanistic refinement, but ex-vivo lysis cannot substitute for clinical recanalization.

proposals.name: Selective A2B blockade during EVLP
proposals.exact_component: ATL802 as the exact A2B antagonist benchmark; a final manufacturable candidate/formulation remains to be specified.

novelty_classification.basis: New exact pharmacological EVLP comparison in the inventory.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Pig transplantation work reported improved compliance with ATL802 during EVLP.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Oxygenation and edema were not improved over EVLP controls; human efficacy and a release-qualified product are absent.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Independently repeat EVLP/transplant physiology with the exact benchmark, requiring a donor/graft functional gain beyond compliance alone and measuring exposure.

disposition.reason: Incomplete functional advantage and product specification keep this behind AAT.

proposals.name: AAT plus solnatide for donor-lung barrier and fluid clearance
proposals.exact_component: Plasma-derived AAT plus solnatide/TIP peptide in EVLP, with each component separately qualified.

novelty_classification.basis: Adds fluid-clearance support to the AAT repair thesis; it does not create independent confirmation of AAT efficacy.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Each component has human-lung preparation evidence addressing related physiological functions.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: The combination has no demonstrated incremental benefit; solnatide clinical boundaries remain relevant.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Only after confirming AAT-alone performance, use a donor-paired factorial EVLP comparison on sustained gas exchange, compliance and fluid clearance after washout.

disposition.reason: Do not add product complexity without superiority to the better single component.

proposals.name: BLU3797 for MTM1-deficient muscle
proposals.exact_component: BLU3797, the published stereodefined PIK3C2B inhibitor, with exact synthesis and Probechem PC-26519 research listing.

novelty_classification.basis: Exact small-molecule counter-enzyme lead replaces earlier MTM1 protein-entry bottlenecks.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Short-term late-start survival/wire-hang rescue in Mtm1-null juvenile mice, selected MTM1-null mouse cells and independent genetic target support.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Mature human patient-muscle force, durable reversal in chronic disease, and a neural safety/exposure margin are missing.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Mature human muscle force at measured exposure plus neural safety separation

disposition.reason: Potentially high-value functional rescue; prioritize human specific force and exposure/selectivity rather than another marker assay.

proposals.name: Transient CPTX protein plus timed rehabilitation after incomplete SCI
proposals.exact_component: CPTX recombinant fusion protein: neurexin-binding cerebellin-1 segment, trimerization element and AMPA-binding neuronal-pentraxin-1 segment; patent SEQ ID NO. 2; timed local pulse plus rehabilitation is proposed.

novelty_classification.basis: Changes timing, injury setting and activity regimen of an existing synaptic-organizer concept.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Published recombinant protein improves mouse SCI function; delayed treatment was in hemisection and immediate treatment in contusion.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Delayed contusion protein efficacy with durable circuit safety is not established by the peer-reviewed study; cell therapy is a different product.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Delayed contusion coordinated motor/conduction benefit after clearance without pathological excitation

disposition.reason: The valuable new contribution is delayed, transient protein benefit under an active rehabilitation comparison.

proposals.name: Post-onset cognate tRNA add-back in YARS1/GARS1 neuropathy
proposals.exact_component: AAV9-U6-tRNATyr; GARS1 cognate tRNA is related separate product

novelty_classification.basis: Specifies the cognate cassette and post-onset question; YARS1 and GARS1 are related products, not independent confirmations of one article.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Neonatal AAV9-U6-tRNATyr prevented functional neuropathy in homozygous Yars1 E196K mice; cognate specificity had informative controls.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Adult/post-onset reversal and delivery in the intended human genotype are unproven; an existing venture program is visible.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Adult/post-onset function; neonatal prevention does not establish reversal

disposition.reason: Strong biology; differentiate through established-disease function and exact product rather than rediscovering the platform.

proposals.name: Exposure-matched piclidenoson in Lowe OCRL deficiency
proposals.exact_component: IB-MECA/piclidenoson; chemically defined A3AR agonist

novelty_classification.basis: New exact indication benchmark found in the screen, coupled to a stricter exposure test.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Human organoid pathway/uptake rescue supports the mechanism.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: The nominal organoid concentration is about eighty-eight-fold above a cited human total Cmax comparator; relevant free kidney exposure is not established.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Receptor-mediated uptake at human-plausible unbound kidney exposure; nominal organoid concentration is ~88x human total Cmax comparator

disposition.reason: Do not promote unless useful receptor-mediated rescue survives human-plausible exposure constraints.

proposals.name: Vanillic acid plus defined CoQ10 formulation in COQ9/selected COQ7 deficiency
proposals.exact_component: Defined vanillic acid plus optimized existing CoQ10 comparator

novelty_classification.basis: Combination is new relative to registry questions but already tested in published mouse work; proposed human function/exposure design is a refinement.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Vanillic acid plus CoQ10 improved survival/motor outcomes in Coq9 R239X mice; COQ7 fibroblasts provide limited human support.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Human COQ9 neural rescue, broad allele applicability and feasible chronic exposure are not established.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Factorial human function, metabolic flux and feasible exposure; genotype restriction

disposition.reason: Chemically concrete and inexpensive to falsify; require incremental tissue function over optimized CoQ10.

proposals.name: 2,4-dihydroxybenzoate add-on in COQ8B nephropathy
proposals.exact_component: 2,4-DHB plus CoQ10; renal gene-specific comparison

novelty_classification.basis: A renal gene-specific CoQ10 add-on design; shares a precursor-bypass family with NM-N05 but uses a different compound and genotype.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: 2,4-DHB showed renal prevention in a podocyte-knockout mouse model and mitochondrial rescue in human knockout cells; CoQ10 has patient comparator evidence.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Incremental podocyte filtration-barrier benefit of the proposed add-on over optimized CoQ10 is unproven.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Incremental human podocyte barrier function over optimized CoQ10

disposition.reason: Do not count this as an independent platform win or generalize across COQ genotypes.

proposals.name: Defined phosphatidylcholine/phosphatidylethanolamine for CMT1A
proposals.exact_component: Composition-defined phosphatidylcholine/phosphatidylethanolamine-rich material modeled on the published approximately 55% PC / 20% PE soy-phospholipid preparation, not unspecified lecithin.

novelty_classification.basis: New inventory mechanism with pre-existing clinical research; the increment is composition, tissue exposure and conduction.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: A defined soy-phospholipid material, approximately fifty-five percent PC and twenty percent PE, improved myelin and neuropathic function in CMT1A rats.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Human nerve delivery, mature conduction benefit and a differentiated product versus the existing clinical research effort remain unproven.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Mature human conduction plus lipid incorporation; no plasma-only surrogate

disposition.reason: Generic lecithin is not a new asset; measured neural incorporation and function could define a useful product.

proposals.name: GCN2iB benchmark for GARS1 neuropathy
proposals.exact_component: GCN2iB with orthogonal GCN2 and ZAK controls

novelty_classification.basis: New pharmacological bypass found and downgraded during the same search.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: GCN2iB improved some onset-treated Gars-mutant mouse motor/conduction endpoints.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: CMAP rescue was not significant; ZAK inhibition and low-dose GCN2 activation undermine clean target attribution.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Distinguish on-target benefit from ZAK inhibition and harmful low-dose GCN2 activation

disposition.reason: Retain as a mechanistic benchmark; a successor must separate GCN2 from ZAK and avoid an adverse low-exposure range.

proposals.name: Immobilized haptoglobin cartridge for CSF hemoglobin removal
proposals.exact_component: Purified haptoglobin immobilized on defined matrix; pressure-controlled device is proposed

novelty_classification.basis: Affinity removal already has precedent; new contribution is a controlled cartridge specification and validated capacity.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Patient-CSF/artery experiments support hemoglobin sequestration/removal and vascular-function restoration.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: An immobilized pressure-controlled device with safe flow, no leaching and adequate rebound capacity has not been validated.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Paired patient-CSF clearance, vascular response, capacity, leachables and rebound; 8–12 independent samples proposed

disposition.reason: A tractable bench/ex-vivo step exists, but safe intracranial circulation is a later product question.

proposals.name: Sildenafil in genotype-defined ATP6 Leigh syndrome
proposals.exact_component: Exact sildenafil exposure matched to neural model; genotype-defined prospective study

novelty_classification.basis: Improves exposure qualification and prospective endpoint design for a published repurposing lead.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: 2026 small/large-mammal experiments and six individually treated Leigh patients support further study.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: The human observations are uncontrolled; genotype-specific benefit and relevant free neural exposure are not established.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Human neural function at plausible free exposure then controlled motor/crisis outcomes

disposition.reason: Test exposure-matched human function before a controlled prospective disease study; do not claim a new molecule.

proposals.name: Sulbactam rescue of aggregation-prone POLG
proposals.exact_component: Sulbactam as the repurposed small-molecule component; final chemical form, exposure and genotype-specific product definition require qualification.

novelty_classification.basis: Root identified this POLG-aggregation lead independently of the thirty domain proposals; no patent novelty is claimed.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: The October 2026 primary report supplies engineered-cell and mouse functional evidence, as reviewed by root.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Engineered HEK/HCT systems are not patient models; the A449T mouse has a mild phenotype, and drug-dose/exposure details need clarification before translational inference.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: In patient-derived or isogenic human cells with endogenous, aggregation-prone POLG variants, demonstrate mtDNA maintenance and respiratory function at measured clinically plausible unbound sulbactam exposure, separating aggregation rescue from nonspecific stress effects.

disposition.reason: Do not outrank direct human organ or mature-muscle proofs until genotype-appropriate patient function and exposure are demonstrated.
